subject: Offer routing + DocuSign timeline for Ethan Cole
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@gmail.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Offer call — quick availability check

Hi Ethan,

Congrats again on a great loop — the team is excited to move forward. I'd like to schedule a short call (15–20 min) to walk through the offer details and next steps. Are you available for any of the following?

- Today (Fri) 11:30 AM PT
- Today 3:00 PM PT
- Monday 9:00 AM PT

If none of those work, send over 2–3 windows that do. We plan to send the offer via DocuSign after the call; if you have any immediate questions (start date flexibility, relocation, etc.) feel free to include them here.

Attachment: Ethan_Cole_Offer_v1.docx (draft for internal routing — not final)

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
(415) 555-0182

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@gmail.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T09:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Offer call — quick availability check

Hi Monica,

Thanks — congrats to the team on building a great process. I can do today at 3:00 PM PT. That works best.

Couple quick items I want to confirm on the call:
- Proposed start date (I was hoping for Aug 16 but can be flexible)
- Whether signing will be handled entirely via DocuSign and typical turnaround
- Any relocation reimbursement paperwork (I live in Portland)

See you at 3.

Best,
Ethan

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Routing: Ethan Cole — offer letter review / redlines?

Hi team,

Per my call with Ethan at 3pm, attached is the draft offer (Ethan_Cole_Offer_v1.docx). Key terms to review:
- Title: Senior Infra Engineer
- Base: $190,000
- Equity: 0.30% vests over 4 years, 1-year cliff
- Sign-on: $20,000 (gross) payable in first payroll
- Start date: proposed Aug 16 (candidate asked for Aug 16; may be flexible)
- Relocation: discretionary stipend — HR to confirm amount and process

Please respond with any redline requests by EOD so we can finalize and send DocuSign tomorrow. If Legal has language notes (IP, confidentiality, restrictive covenants) please flag inline.

Attachments: Ethan_Cole_Offer_v1.docx

Thanks,
Monica
Senior Recruiter | Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Routing: Ethan Cole — offer letter review / redlines?

Thanks Monica — I reviewed and left two suggested edits in the attached redline: change the start date to Aug 30 (we have a team offsite week of Aug 17 that would be helpful) and specify prorated bonus eligibility for new hires joining after Q3 start. Otherwise comp looks good.

Quick notes inline:
- Start date: prefer Aug 30 instead of Aug 16 (team availability)
- Reporting: add manager title explicitly (Director, Infra)

I don't expect legal to push back on anything else, but happy to discuss if Laura sees a problem.

Attachment: Ethan_Cole_Offer_redlines.docx

-Markus
Director of Infrastructure | Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, markus_klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Routing: Ethan Cole — offer letter review / redlines?

All — reviewed. HR confirms a standard relocation stipend up to $8,000 for roles at this level; I'll add a short paragraph and the reimbursement process. Compensation and equity approved as-is.

Aditya — any quick IP/contract clauses you want to flag? If not, I can finish final formatting and Monica can send the DocuSign link.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Operations | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@gmail.com>
Cc: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-10T15:48:00-07:00
Subject: Final offer + DocuSign link (Ethan Cole)

Hi Ethan — great speaking earlier. Attached is the final offer; we made one scheduling adjustment (start date Aug 30) to align with a team kickoff, and included the relocation stipend details.

What happens next:
1) Please review and sign via DocuSign here: https://app.docusign.com/eyJhbGci.../envelope/0a1b2c3d
2) Once signed, People Ops will send onboarding paperwork and confirm first-day logistics
3) If you prefer Aug 16 instead of Aug 30, reply here and we'll treat as a request — markus has tentatively approved flexibility but wants to know as soon as possible

Attachment: Ethan_Cole_Offer_Final.pdf (sent via DocuSign)

Let me know if you want to chat before signing. Looking forward to having you on the team.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
